x: Other members of our team finished—21 Eric Herbert, 23 Tom Morrell, 25 Stan Eales, 32 Syd Jarlett, 39 Con Abberton, 42 Gordon Doubleday. The team championship resulted—1 Belgrave Harriers 45 points; 2 Herne Hill H. 74 points; 3 Surrey A.C. 101 points.

…Dick Tobin, Geoff Pearson, Tom Clinton and Tom Carter, who were all members of our last winning “ National ” team; also Stan Eales, who backed up our teams so well last season; but these members cannot carry on for ever, and it is to the newer members that we look to to carry the Belgrave colours to…
They did very well to finish in 4th place, beating clubs such as Herne Hill, Cambridge and Finchley, and our men's positions and times were as under:— 10 S.

Gosney of Eastleigh beat Olney the local "crack" in the individual race, but our lads packed well with Tom Clinton 4th, Dick Towndrow 5th, Ted Stimpson 6th and Frank Abberton 7th. Other club placings were: Eric Herbert 10, Les Stokell 12, Stan Eales 14, A.
Stan Eales, recently married, was a spectator at the Club 10 miles Championship at Wimbledon.

Rather naturally there were new names in our team in Vic Blowfield, George Lucas, Stan Eales, Eric Herbert and Albert Frost. It is interesting to note that of our ten runners, six were past or future Internationals.

This however did fall once again to LEN HERBERT (6th); and other members of our team on this most difficult day were :- DICK TOBIN 31, VIC BLOWFIELD 37, TED STIMPSON (this years President - none other) 51, STAN EALES 65.
